name: @dndtools/gm-react
author: tsieb <trentonsieb@gmail.com>
description: Parallel React prototype of the DND Tools GM workspace — the design-package command-center kit, ported to a real Vite + React app wired to @dndtools/core. Isolated from the production SvelteKit app (@dndtools/gm).

scripts.desktop:dev: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,magenta "vite --port 5273" "wait-on tcp:5273 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5273 electron ."
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm run desktop:bundle-discovery && vite build && electron-builder
scripts.desktop:build:dir: pnpm run desktop:bundle-discovery && vite build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.desktop:smoke: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && vite build && node scripts/run-desktop-smoke.mjs
